question: Where should the placement of the mother-letters be arranged after it has been performed?
premises: The placement of the mother-letters is first performed.
The arrangement is to be extended further.
The clan-limb is included as a locus for arrangement.
inference: After performing the placement of the mother-letters, one should also arrange it in the clan-limb.
uncertainties: The exact referent of kula+aṅge is context-dependent.
plain_english: Having performed the placement of the mother-letters, one should also arrange it in the limb of the clan.
